scenes.setting: Audrey's high tea for her blue-blooded mysticism enthusiasts: steered by her, the questions pull from MI9's Kance what she wants — gas explosion, poison, substitutes, Specter's Shriek, holy bullets, a specter-state Hero Bandit, and more than one powerful Beyonder guarding a mere trafficker
scenes.text_anchor: “Do you want me to be locked up by Captain?”

scenes.setting: Noon at Minsk Street: Old Kohler's emergency letter, penned in Daisy's neat free-school handwriting — she is safely home, and would like her vocabulary book back; burned after reading, with a chuckle: 'Captain, now it's my turn to approve the expense claims of others…'
scenes.text_anchor: “Captain, now it’s my turn to approve the expense claims of others…”

scenes.setting: Quelaag Club corner table: two hires in one afternoon — Mike Joseph wants him along to interview the rescued East Borough girls (and quietly sniff out the Hero Bandit), and Dr. Aaron wants a bodyguard tonight while he confronts the child with the inverted Wheel of Fortune

scenes.setting: City of Silver: Derrick reexamines the twelve-ringed translucent worm — too shy to trouble Mr. Fool again, he'll show it at the next gathering — then heads out to meet Shepherd Elder Lovia's returning temple expedition
